mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_turn_metric (conversation_id, message_id, user_id, model, prompt_version, rounds, tool_calls, tool_cost_ms, total_cost_ms, input_tokens, output_tokens, capped, cap_reason, source, outcome, trace_id) VALUES (#{conversationId}, #{messageId}, #{userId}, #{model}, #{promptVersion}, #{rounds}, #{toolCalls}, #{toolCostMs}, #{totalCostMs}, #{inputTokens}, #{outputTokens}, #{capped}, #{capReason}, #{source}, #{outcome}, #{traceId})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS turns, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN outcome = 'ERROR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS error_turns, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN capped = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS capped_turns, AVG(rounds) AS avg_rounds, AVG(total_cost_ms) AS avg_total_cost_ms, COALESCE(SUM(input_tokens), 0) AS input_tokens, COALESCE(SUM(output_tokens), 0) AS output_tokens FROM ai_turn_metric WHERE created_at >= #{from} AND created_at < #{to}

SELECT DATE(created_at) AS stat_date, COUNT(*) AS turns, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN outcome = 'ERROR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS error_turns, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN capped = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS capped_turns, AVG(rounds) AS avg_rounds, AVG(total_cost_ms) AS avg_total_cost_ms, COALESCE(SUM(input_tokens), 0) AS input_tokens, COALESCE(SUM(output_tokens), 0) AS output_tokens FROM ai_turn_metric WHERE created_at >= #{from} AND created_at < #{to} GROUP BY DATE(created_at) ORDER BY stat_date

SELECT t.tool_name AS tool_name, COUNT(*) AS calls, AVG(t.duration_ms) AS avg_duration_ms, MAX(t.duration_ms) AS max_duration_ms, MIN(CASE WHEN t.rn >= CEIL(t.cnt * 0.95) THEN t.duration_ms END) AS p95_duration_ms FROM ( SELECT c.tool_name AS tool_name, c.duration_ms AS duration_ms, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.tool_name ORDER BY c.duration_ms) AS rn, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY c.tool_name) AS cnt FROM ai_tool_call c WHERE c.created_at >= #{from} AND c.created_at < #{to} AND c.is_deleted = 0 ) t GROUP BY t.tool_name ORDER BY calls DESC, t.tool_name LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT p.status AS status, COUNT(*) AS status_count FROM ai_operation_proposal p WHERE p.created_at >= #{from} AND p.created_at < #{to} AND p.is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY p.status ORDER BY status_count DESC, p.status
